notes: Support Nebula. A new section in Settings, once a support link is set up: chip in if you like — nothing that exists moves behind it. A supporter gets a small mark beside their name (friends see it too), three more accent colours (Gold, Ice, Mint) and, if they switch it on, their name on the wall in Settings and on the website. Codes come with the thank-you and are typed once on any signed-in device; the mark follows the profile. On a TV the section shows a QR and a short address to open on a phone.
